page_title: AUX 2-2 TOU | Auxerre v Toulouse 09/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) swings in a cross from the corner, but Kjetil Haug reads it well and gathers the ball.
90+4' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
89' 2 - 2 Noah Edjouma (Toulouse) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly sends the ball into the back of the net.
88' Frank Magri (Toulouse) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
85' A dangerous towering header by Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) from around the penalty spot goes just over the bar. This corner kick didn't change the score.
84' Good work from Toulouse as they win a corner.

83' Frank Magri (Toulouse) picks up a cross inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the right side of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Donovan Leon, who pulls off a stunning save!
83' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
83' Here's the change. Hamed Junior Traore leaves the pitch and Theo Bair (Auxerre) comes on as a substitute.
83' Christophe Pelissier has decided to substitute Elisha Owusu and he is replaced by Assane Diousse (Auxerre).
77' The substitution has been made. Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse) has replaced Rafik Messali.
77' Jaydee Canvot (Toulouse) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
74' Jerome Brisard shows a yellow card to Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) for a tough tackle.
73' 2 - 1 Goal! Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) picks up a pass and gets to the edge of the box before clipping a brilliant lob over the goalkeeper and into the empty net. He makes it 2:1.
72' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Toulouse comes to nothing.
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Zakaria Aboukhlal trots off the pitch and is replaced by Noah Edjouma (Toulouse).
68' 1 - 1 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header into the middle of the goal. He makes it 1:1.
68' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
68' Christophe Pelissier decides to make a substitution. Han-Noah Massengo will be replaced by Kevin Danois (Auxerre).
68' Substitution. Paul Joly (Auxerre) replaces Ki-Jana Hoever.

62' 1 - 0 Goal! The ball is swung into the box from the resulting corner kick and finds Jubal Junior (Auxerre), who jumps highest and tries his luck with a header from around the penalty spot. His effort is both strong and precise enough to go inside the right post. The score changes to 1:0.
62' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) takes the corner.
62' Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Auxerre will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

61' What a wasted chance that was! A precise cross into the box finds Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre), whose header flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Toulouse.
60' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) misses a good chance to score. A perfect cross into the box finds Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) who rises for a header, but he sends the ball well over the bar.
59' The resulting set piece from Toulouse is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
57' The game has come to an end for Florian Aye. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre).
54' Auxerre quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

53' Ki-Jana Hoever (Auxerre) produced a promising shot towards the right side of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Kjetil Haug thwarted him with a fabulous save and the score remains the same. The ball goes out of play and Auxerre have been awarded a corner kick.
52' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Toulouse, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
46' Carles Martinez has made a change at the break. Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) has come on in place of Mark McKenzie.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
45+3' The linesman signals that Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Here’s the VAR verdict on that penalty incident – NO PENALTY for Toulouse! Play can continue.
42' There's a break in play and referee Jerome Brisard must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Toulouse using VAR. This could be interesting!
42' One of the Toulouse players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
39' Problems for Carles Martinez as Joshua King is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Frank Magri (Toulouse) replaces him.
39' Joshua King (Toulouse) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
35' It looks like Joshua King (Toulouse) saw red with that tackle. Jerome Brisard won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
33' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
30' Joshua King (Toulouse) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
24' Jerome Brisard has a clear sight and sees a foul from Gabriel Osho (Auxerre).
22' Jubal Junior (Auxerre) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jerome Brisard no option but to blow his whistle.
18' Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
15' Rough tackle by Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
12' Han-Noah Massengo (Auxerre) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
10' Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for a foul.
5' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
4' Jerome Brisard blows his whistle. Ki-Jana Hoever (Auxerre) commits a foul after dangerous play.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Auxerre will kick-off.
Jerome Brisard was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
